Title: General availability: Azure Archive Storage now available in Switzerland North

Body.Content:
Azure Archive Storage provides a secure, low-cost means for retaining cold data including backup and archival storage. Now, Azure Archive Storage is available in Switzerland North. For a complete list of regions, see Azure products available by region.

For more information about Azure Archive Storage, see Access archive tier for Azure Blob Storage.
